prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-oriented animation KEYFRAME storyboard for a 360x360 circular companion display. Inspired by the minimalist expressive eyes of NIO NOMI, but an original unbranded character. ONLY TWO LARGE SOLID warm-white luminous oval eyes floating on pure black. NO pupils, no iris, no eye holes except intentional closed eyelid shapes, no mouth, no nose, NO whiskers, no ears, no animal characteristics, no eyebrows, no cheeks, no extra symbols, no text, no logo, no physical device. Eyes are softly rounded vertical ovals, friendly and beautifully proportioned, flat 2D shapes with crisp antialiased edges and almost no glow. Express emotions entirely by squashing stretching rotating and moving the two solid white eye shapes. EXACT layout 4 rows x4 columns of equal square black cells separated by thin charcoal grid lines. Each row depicts 4 consecutive KEYFRAMES of one animation left-to-right. Keep two eyes centered at the SAME vertical midline in all neutral frames; generous circular-screen safe area. Eye pair occupies 55% of cell width. Identical character scale throughout. Large square high resolution sheet. ROW1 wake: two thin horizontal sleeping slits; half-height rounded eyes; fully open tall ovals; relaxed standard ovals. ROW2 move-off: standard ovals; both slightly squash with anticipation; tall delighted ovals leaning upward slightly; happy closed upward arches. ROW3 acceleration: standard ovals; pair slightly lag to viewer right and tilt; playful narrow happy arches; standard tall attentive ovals. ROW4 cruise: standard open ovals; half-height ovals; two thin curved happy closed eyelids; same standard ovals.
